main_text_excerpt: Champions of low carbon energy and services Delivering the UK’s energy transition through reduced energy consumption and environmentally friendly solutions. Champions of low carbon energy and services Reconciling economic performance with a positive impact on people and the planet Champions of low carbon energy and services Offering innovative and competitive customer solutions About ENGIE ENGIE is a global reference in low carbon energy and services and in the UK we’re expert in renewable energy, flexibility, and customer solutions. We own and operate onshore and offshore wind assets, solar farms and biomethane plants, producing green power and gas. We are the UK’s largest provider of highly flexible energy storage for both electricity and gas. Our asset portfolio includes Storengy UK, the country’s largest onshore gas storage facility and our pumped storage hydropower plant in Dinorwig, the largest of its kind in Europe. ENGIE supplies 17,000 business customers and organisations of all sizes, supporting them to decarbonise. And our energy market experts balance portfolios, optimise energy assets, and manage market risks for various partners. We’re entering a new era. One that’s clean, affordable and reliable. One that’ll help us achieve a carbon neutral economy and protect the planet for generations to come. We’re proud to be driving this change and accelerating the energy transition. headings: H3: RECC Reinforces its value in the role of Consumer Protection following MCS Update
main_text_excerpt: Search our members Find members of the Renewable Energy Consumer Code. Find out more Top Tips for consumers Tips for consumers thinking of generating their own energy. Find out more Join the Consumer Code How to join Renewable Energy Consumer Code (RECC). Find out more Who we are RECC sets out high consumer protection standards for businesses who are selling or leasing renewable energy generation systems to domestic consumers. RECC is approved by Chartered Trading Standards Institute as part of the Consumer Codes Approval Scheme and is also a TrustMark Scheme Operator. Our Code By displaying the logo RECC Members signal they have agreed to abide by the high standards set out in the Consumer Code , following the consumer journey from start to finish, and in the Bye-Laws . Both the Code and the Bye-Laws dovetail with the Microgeneration Certification Scheme (MCS) installer standards. Our technologies RECC members work with a range of renewable technologies from solar photovoltaic (PV) systems, solar water heating systems, ground and air source heat pumps and boilers fuelled by wood chips or pellets . They also work with common 'add-ons' such as battery storage systems, voltage optimisers and i-boost systems .
